---
title: '02_smoothing'
---

```{r setup}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(doRNG)

# Empty work space
rm(list = ls())

# Avoid scientific notation
options(scipen = 999)

# Load data
load("data/data_final.RData")

# Set seed
set.seed(123)

```

```{r}

# --- 1. CONFIGURATION ---
bs_iterations <- 250
n_cluster <- 10

if (!dir.exists("outputs/bootstraps")) dir.create("outputs/bootstraps", recursive = TRUE)

# --- 2. DATA PREP ---
data_lfs <- data_lfs |> mutate(stratum = interaction(country_code_3d, sex, sep = "_", drop = TRUE))

# Define Formulas
formula_list <- list(
  "formula_A" = formula("outcome ~ factor(year_binned_region) + s(as.numeric(age_bracket), by = factor(year_binned_region), bs = 'cr', k = 3)"),    # regions and 1-year ages
  "formula_B" = formula("outcome ~ factor(year_binned) + s(as.numeric(age_bracket), by = factor(year_binned), bs = 'cr', k = 3)"),                  # no regions and 1-year ages
  "formula_C" = formula("outcome ~ factor(year_binned_region) * factor(age_bracket)"),                                                              # regions and age bins
  "formula_D" = formula("outcome ~ factor(year_binned) * factor(age_bracket)"))                                                                     # no regions and age bins

# --- DRAW STRATUM ---
for (j in unique(data_lfs$stratum)) {
  
  message(paste("Processing Stratum:", j))
  data_stratum <- data_lfs |> filter(stratum == j)
  
  # formula selection: single years of age or 5-year age bins, one or several regions
  age_in_single_years <- !all(is.na(data_stratum$age))
  several_regions     <- n_distinct(data_stratum$region) > 1

  formula_key <-
    if (several_regions  && age_in_single_years) "formula_A" else
    if (!several_regions && age_in_single_years) "formula_B" else
    if (several_regions)                         "formula_C" else
                                                 "formula_D"

  message(paste("  formula:", formula_key))
  
  # 1. PRE-SORT GRIDS
  if (formula_key %in% c("formula_A", "formula_B")) {
    pred_grid <- data_stratum |> 
      select(country_code_3d, region, year_binned, year_binned_region, sex, age_bracket) |> 
      unique() |>
      arrange(country_code_3d, region, year_binned, sex, age_bracket) |> 
      ungroup() |> 
      group_by(country_code_3d, year_binned_region, region, year_binned, sex) |> 
      expand(age_bracket = 50:74)
  }
  
  if (formula_key %in% c("formula_C", "formula_D")) {
    pred_grid <- data_stratum |> 
      select(country_code_3d, region, year_binned, year_binned_region, sex, age_bracket) |> 
      unique() |>
      arrange(country_code_3d, region, year_binned, sex, age_bracket) |> 
      ungroup() |> 
      group_by(country_code_3d, year_binned_region, region, year_binned, sex) |> 
      expand(age_bracket = c("Y50-54", "Y55-59", "Y60-64", "Y65-69", "Y70-74"))
  }

  # 2. BOOTSTRAP
  
  # --- PARALLEL SETUP ---
  cluster <- makeCluster(n_cluster)
  registerDoParallel(cluster)

  invisible(foreach(i = 1:bs_iterations, .packages = c("tidyverse", "mgcv")) %dorng% {
    
    boot_sample <- data_stratum |>
      group_by(year) |>
      slice_sample(prop = 1, replace = TRUE) |>
      ungroup()
    
    # --- MODEL 1: PREVALENCE ---
    boot_sample$outcome <- ifelse(boot_sample$lm_status == "employed", 1, 0)
    
    fit_prev <- bam(
      formula  = formula_list[[formula_key]],
      data     = boot_sample,
      family   = quasibinomial(link = "logit"),
      method   = "fREML",
      weights  = weight,
      nthreads = 1,
      discrete = F)
    
    # Predict
    vec_prev <- predict(fit_prev, newdata = pred_grid, type = "response")
    
    # --- MODEL 2: WORKING HOURS ---
    boot_sample$outcome <- boot_sample$working_hours_norm
    
    fit_hours <- bam(
      formula  = formula_list[[formula_key]],
      data     = boot_sample,
      family   = quasibinomial(link = "logit"),
      method   = "fREML",
      weights  = weight,
      nthreads = 1,
      discrete = F)
    
    # Predict
    vec_hours <- predict(fit_hours, newdata = pred_grid, type = "response")
    
    # --- COMBINE & UNGROUP ---
    results_iter <- pred_grid
    results_iter$prev <- vec_prev
    results_iter$hours <- vec_hours
    
    # ungroup if age is not provided in single years
    if (formula_key %in% c("formula_C", "formula_D")) {
      
      # create unique region-year-sex combinations
      wle_iter_comb <- results_iter |> select(region, year_binned, sex) |> unique()

      ungrouped = data.frame()

      for (k in 1:nrow(wle_iter_comb)) {
  
        # retrieve region-year-sex combination
        comb <- results_iter |> 
          filter(
            region == wle_iter_comb$region[k] & 
            year_binned == wle_iter_comb$year_binned[k] &
            sex == wle_iter_comb$sex[k]) |>
          mutate(
            country_code_3d = as.character(country_code_3d),
            region = as.character(region),
            year_binned = as.character(year_binned),
            sex = as.character(sex)) |>
          ungroup()
  
        # logit scale; predictions on the boundary are moved just inside (0, 1)
        logit <- function(p) {
          p <- pmin(pmax(p, 1e-10), 1 - 1e-10)
          log(p / (1 - p))
        }

        log_prev  <- logit(comb$prev)
        log_hours <- logit(comb$hours)
  
        # create cumulative rates to guarantee that single years average corresponds to 5-year bin
        log_prev_cum <- c(0, cumsum(log_prev * 5))
        log_hours_cum <- c(0, cumsum(log_hours * 5))
  
        # fit spline
        spline_prev <- spline(x = c(50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75), y = log_prev_cum, method = "natural", n = 26)
        spline_hours <- spline(x = c(50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75), y = log_hours_cum, method = "natural", n = 26)
  
        # transform back into rates at single ages
        single_year_prev <- exp(diff(spline_prev$y)) / (1 + exp(diff(spline_prev$y)))
        single_year_hours <- exp(diff(spline_hours$y)) / (1 + exp(diff(spline_hours$y)))
  
        # add back to region-year-sex combination
        comb <- comb |>
          expand(country_code_3d = country_code_3d, region = region, year_binned = year_binned, sex = sex, age_bracket = 50:74) |>
          mutate(prev = single_year_prev, hours = single_year_hours)
      
        ungrouped <- rbind(ungrouped, comb)
      
      }
      
      results_iter <- ungrouped
      
    }
    
    message(paste("Processing Bootstrap Iteration:", i))

    # add year_binned_region
    region_keys <- data_stratum |>
      ungroup() |>
      select(country_code_3d, region, year_binned, year_binned_region, sex) |>
      unique() |>
      mutate(across(c(country_code_3d, region, year_binned, sex), as.character))

    results_iter <- results_iter |>
      ungroup() |>
      mutate(
        across(c(country_code_3d, region, year_binned, sex), as.character),
        age_bracket  = as.numeric(age_bracket),
        prev         = as.numeric(prev),
        hours        = as.numeric(hours),
        bs_iteration = i) |>
      left_join(region_keys, by = c("country_code_3d", "region", "year_binned", "sex"))

    stopifnot(!any(is.na(results_iter$year_binned_region)))

    prev_iter <- results_iter |>
      select(country_code_3d, region, year_binned, year_binned_region, sex,
             age_bracket, prev, bs_iteration)

    saveRDS(prev_iter, paste0("outputs/bootstraps/emp_", j, "_", i, ".rds"))

    hours_iter <- results_iter |>
      select(country_code_3d, region, year_binned, year_binned_region, sex,
             age_bracket, hours, bs_iteration)

    saveRDS(hours_iter, paste0("outputs/bootstraps/hours_", j, "_", i, ".rds"))

  })

  stopCluster(cluster)
  
}

```
